Nell: Quick poll  Rina's bday next Wed. Office treat: cookie jar (easy to share) or tiny desk cactus (low maintenance & shipable)?
Omar: cactus 331 for sure. Ships well.
Rina: cactus please! less sugar :)
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started  cookie jar 0, cactus 2
Jo: Cookie jar gives everyone a little moment though. also add "no nuts" label if we do snacks.
Nell: Good point re allergies. If cactus wins, we'll add a small card + care note.
Omar: I can pick up 6 mini cacti from GreenStreet on Mon. They wrap for mailing.
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder created: "Buy mini cacti" scheduled at 1912410000.
Jo: I'll handle cards. Also setting a 5-min birthday channel message at 11:30.
Nell: Final tally cactus 3, cookie jar 1. Cactus it is. Thanks y'all! :tada:
